description: Without campaign_id, creates a campaign from one source (address, file_urls, shop_product or shop_products); needs name, type, description, platform, budget, started_at, ended_at, geo_target, needs_shipping_address, and product_name unless a shop product is given. A create call with every needed value sets the campaign up at once and its reply lists what was stored; creating it sends nothing, charges nothing and needs no confirming call. A creator search charges tokens. needs_shipping_address has no default, and the product, brand, budget and dates are the marketer's own values. An owner or admin naming a new brand with address creates it and reads its website. With campaign_id, updates that campaign; budget, geo_target, product_name or shop_product(s), needs_shipping_address and commission_rate can change, each in a call without other fields, and the reply states each old and new value; type and platform cannot change, so a different one means a new campaign. product_kind and buyer describe the product as the brand's site shows it. BRAND.md is already on the server, so description holds only what this campaign needs, never pasted brand documents. Example: campaign_id spring-launch with the one field the marketer changed.

address.description: Brand or product page (https); replaces product links on update.

attribution.description: How sales are credited; a new campaign defaults to none.

brand.description: Brand handle or exact name; with campaign_id, that campaign's brand.

budget.description: Campaign budget in whole currency units (>= 0).

campaign_id.description: Campaign handle to update; omit it to create.

commission_rate.description: Affiliate commission in percent (15 = 15%); affiliate_marketing only.

cost_per_contract.description: Per-contract creator cost. Required when type is paid_collaboration.

export_sheet.description: With campaign_id only: writes the campaign's roster or results to the brand's Google Sheets tab at once; a repeat updates its rows.

file_urls.description: Brand file links (https); replace brand materials on update.

geo_target.description: Target market as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Accepted codes: US, KR, JP, CA, GB, AU, FR, DE, IT, ES, NL, SE, NO, DK, FI, IE, CH, AT, BE, PT, PL, CZ, GR, TR, AE, SA, IL, IN, CN, TW, HK, SG, TH, VN, ID, PH, MY, BR, MX, AR, CL, CO, ZA, EG.

has_free_sample.description: Creators get a free product sample; affiliate_marketing only; create only.

needs_shipping_address.description: Whether creators receive a physical product; no default.

platform.description: Primary social platform for the campaign.

product_category.description: Optional product category, e.g. "Beauty & Personal Care". A connector creator search narrows to it only when it is sent as target_categories; a first connector search that names no category uses the categories that fit the brand profile. Accepted categories, written exactly: Art & Design, AI & Technology, Architecture & Construction, Arts & Crafts, Automotive, Beauty & Personal Care, Books & Literature, Business & Finance, Culture & Entertainment, Education & Learning, Events & Activities, Fashion & Style, Food & Drink, Gaming, Health & Wellness, Home & Living, Idols & Fandom, News & Media, Pets, Photography & Videography, Relationships & Family, Science & Nature, Sports & Outdoors, Travel & Tourism, Webcomics & Animation, Religion & Spirituality. Each has subcategories, listed by fetch with target "targeting-vocabulary". A name outside the list is searched as the accepted category it spells or aliases; any other name is not searched.

sections.description: With campaign_id only, and alone: CAMPAIGN.md headings to write, each once. Headings only in one call, saved all or none; or exactly one Learned Facts entry. A call naming Playbook Overrides or Learned Facts saves nothing and returns a proposal with a confirmation_ref; a call with the same sections and that confirmation_ref saves it.

expected_text.description: Learned Facts mode remove: the exact text of the item to delete.

expected_version.description: mode replace only: ISO version, or empty for a first write.

mode.description: replace (default), append (Learned Facts only), or remove (Learned Facts only).

text.description: mode replace: the heading body, null clears it. Learned Facts mode append: the one item to add, one line, such as a rule in the marketer's own words followed by the member name and date in parentheses.

shop_action.description: Shop connection, affiliate access or a listing edit; answered with a web app link, nothing is set up.

shop_product.description: A product id or exact title of the brand's TikTok Shop; create only.

shop_products.description: Several product ids or exact titles of the brand's TikTok Shop; create only.

sync_inventory.description: With campaign_id: proposes the brand's Google Sheets stock as one Learned Facts item; confirmation_ref saves it.

type.description: Campaign type: seeding (gifting), paid_collaboration, or affiliate_marketing (a TikTok Shop affiliate campaign).

name: setup_campaign
title: Set Up Campaign
